book.name: HEBREOS
book.title: HEBREOS SUK YACHACHIKUK RUNA KREYIKUK HEBREOMASINKUNATA KILLKARKAN

content: Tata Dios willawanchisapa paywan tantalla kushikushpa kawsananchikunapa.

Tata Dios awilunchikunatashina ñukanchikunatapish willawanchisapa paywan tantalla kushikushpa kawsananchikunapa. Chashna willawaptinchikuna akuychi kuydanakuypachi ama Tata Diosmanta ashunanchikunapa.

Tata Dios chay ñawpa awilunchikunatashina ñukanchikunatapish willawashkanchisapa kuyawashpanchikuna uchanchikunamanta salvawananchikunata. Chay awilunchikuna Tata Diospa rimananta uyarishpankunapish mana munarkansapachu tukuy shunku payta kreyishpa kawsayta. Chayrayku mana atiparkansapachu chay alli kushikunankuna llaktapi yaykuyta.
Tata Dios killkadunpi rimarkan:

content.text: “Chay runakuna mana kasuwanayaptinkuna sukaman piñakushpa willarkanisapa
ama chay alli kushikunankuna llaktapi yaykunankunapa.”

content: Chay runakuna mana kushikunan llaktapi yaykuptinkunapish ñukanchikuna Jesukristuta allita kreyishkanchikunarayku Tata Dioswan kushikushpalla kawsashunchisapa. Tata Dios tukuy tiyakta rurashkanmantapacha kushikushpa kawsaykan. Chayrayku munan ñukanchikunapish paywan tantalla kushikushpalla kawsananchikunapa.
Tata Diospa killkadun willawanchisapa:

content.text: “Soktaynin diya Tata Dios tukuy rurashkanta tukuchashpa kushikushpa samarkan.”

content: Chashna Tata Dios yachachiwanchisapa yanapawaptinchikuna kushikushpalla kawsananchikunapa.
Chaymanta Tata Dios killkadunpi kashkan willawanchisapa:

content.text: “Chay kushikunan llaktapi chay runakuna mana yaykunkasapachu.”

content: Kunankamanlla Tata Dios munan paywan tantalla kushikushpa kawsananchikunapa. Chay ñawpa awilunchikuna Tata Dios salvakuk kananta yachashpankunapish chay rimanata mana kasurkansapachu. Chayrayku mana atiparkansapachu chay kushikunankuna llaktapi yaykuyta.
Paykuna mana yaykuptinkuna aypa watakuna washa Tata Dios awilunchi Davidta kashkan willarkan:

content.text: “Kunan rimanaynita allita uyarishpaykichi ama sinchi shunku tukuychichu.”

content: Chayta willashpa Tata Dios yachachiwanchisapa kunankaman munananllata tukuy runakuna payta kasushpa kushikushpa kawsananchikunapa.

Chaymanta Josueta katik runakuna chay kushikunan llaktapi yaykushpankunapish mana kushikushpachu kawsarkansapa. Allita kushikushpa kawsashkankuna kaptinka aypa watakuna washan Tata Dios mana kashkan willanmansapachu karkan payta kasushpa kushikushpa kawsanankunapa.
Chashna Tata Dios paykunata willashpa yachachiwanchisapa kunankaman munananta ñukanchikunapish paywan tantalla kushikushpa kawsananchikunapa.
Tata Dios tukuy tiyakta rurashkanwasha kushikushpa samarkan. Ñukanchikunapish Tata Dios kushikushkanshina sukaman kushikushpa mana turbakushpa payllata kreyishpa kawsashunchisapa.
Chayrayku akuychi sinchikushpa Tata Diosta allita kasushpa kawsaypachi paywan tantalla kushikushpa kawsananchikunapa. Ama chay ñawpa mana kasunayak runakunashina kawsaypachichu.

Tata Diospa rimanan atipachiwanchisapa mushuk layata allita rurashpa kawsananchikunapa. Ishkantin ladunpi filuyuk machetimanta Tata Diospa rimananka ashwan filuyukshinami. Shunkunchikunapi kawachiwanchisapa yuyananchikuna munananchikuna allichu manachu nishpa.

Tata Dios tukuy yuyayninchikunata allita riksin. Tata Dios rurawashkanchikuna kaptin paymanta mana atipanchimansapachu pakakuyta. Paytaka tukuy alli mana alli rurashkanchikunata willananchikuna tiyan.
Jesukristu sukaman sufrishkanrayku atipan yanapawayninchikunata.

Tata Diospa chaylla wambran Jesukristu kawsamushkanwasha Tata Diospa kawsanan sielupi yaykurkan alli kamachikuk saserdotenchikuna kananpa. Chayrayku imashnacha Jesukristu kreyinanchikunata willashkanchikunashina akuychi mana shaykushpa payllata allita kreyishpa kawsaypachi.

Jesukristu kay allpapi kawsashpa ñukanchikunashina rikchak layata sufrirkan. Chashna sukaman sufrishpapish mana niman suk kuti uchallikurkanchu. Rikchak layata sufrishkanrayku yachan sufrinanchikunata. Chayrayku saserdotenchikuna kashpa atipan llakichiwashpanchikuna yanapawayninchikunata.

Chayrayku sufrishpanchikuna akuychi Tata Diospa kamachikunan tiyarinanman riypachi allita yachashpa sukaman kuyawashpanchikuna yanapawananchikunata. Chayta yachashpa payta roygaypachi llakichiwashpanchikuna yanapawananchikunapa.
